title: Load PulseAudio module at runtime
summary: Load a specific PulseAudio module without restarting the daemon. This is useful for testing features like echo cancellation or equalizers.

steps.explain: Load a module by name. Replace <MODULE_NAME> with the module name (e.g., module-equalizer-sink).

placeholders.name: MODULE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the module to load, e.g., 'module-equalizer-sink'.
